items.en: Affect is usually a verb (to influence); effect is usually a noun (a result).
items.ex: Rain can affect the harvest; the effect is lower prices.
items.tip: A for Action (affect), E for End result (effect).

items.en: Accept means to receive or agree; except means leaving out.
items.ex: I accept every suggestion except the last one.
items.tip: EXcept EXcludes.

items.en: Advice is a noun (a suggestion); advise is a verb (to suggest).
items.ex: I advise you to follow your teacher's advice.
items.tip: Ice is a thing (advice); is is an action (advise).

items.en: Complement means to complete or suit; compliment means praise.
items.ex: The colours complement each other, and guests paid her a compliment.
items.tip: ComplEment complEtes; complIment: I like it.

items.en: Principal means main or head of a school; principle means a rule or belief.
items.ex: Our principal never breaks a principle.
items.tip: The principAL is your pAL; a principLE is a ruLE.

items.en: Stationary means not moving; stationery means paper and pens.
items.ex: The van was stationary outside the stationery shop.
items.tip: stationEry: Envelopes; stationAry: stAy.

items.en: Lose means fail to keep; loose means not tight.
items.ex: If the screw is loose, you may lose it.
items.tip: Loose has an extra o, like extra room.

items.en: Emigrate means leave your country; immigrate means come into a new country.
items.bn: দেশ ছেড়ে যাওয়া বনাম অন্য দেশে বসবাসে আসা
items.hi: देश छोड़ना बनाम दूसरे देश में आकर बसना
items.ex: They emigrate from India and immigrate to Canada.
items.tip: Emigrate = Exit; Immigrate = In.

items.en: Eminent means famous and respected; imminent means about to happen.
items.ex: An eminent scientist warned that a storm was imminent.
items.tip: IMMinent: IMMediately.

items.en: Council is a group of people; counsel means advice or to advise.
items.ex: The council sought legal counsel.
items.tip: CounSEL: SELl advice.

items.en: Desert is a dry land (or to abandon); dessert is a sweet dish.
items.ex: In the desert we dreamt of a cold dessert.
items.tip: Dessert has two s's: you want seconds.

items.en: Ensure means make certain; insure means protect with insurance.
items.ex: Ensure you insure your new bike.
items.tip: Insure: Insurance.

items.en: Precede means come before; proceed means go forward.
items.ex: A short prayer will precede the event; then we will proceed.
items.tip: PREcede = PREvious.

items.en: Elicit means draw out; illicit means illegal.
items.ex: The officer tried to elicit details about the illicit trade.
items.tip: ILLicit = ILLegal.

items.en: Discreet means careful and tactful; discrete means separate.
items.ex: Be discreet; the data falls into discrete groups.
items.tip: In discrete, the t separates the e's.

items.en: Canvas is strong cloth; canvass means ask for votes or opinions.
items.ex: Volunteers carried canvas bags to canvass for votes.
items.tip: Canvass has an extra s for 'seeking support'.

items.en: Allusion is an indirect reference; illusion is a false appearance.
items.ex: The poem's allusion to the epic created an illusion of age.
items.tip: ILLusion fools the eye.

items.en: Adapt means adjust; adopt means take as one's own.
items.ex: Families who adopt a pet must adapt their routine.
items.tip: Adopt: Own.

items.en: Continual means repeated often; continuous means without a break.
items.ex: Continual phone calls and continuous noise ruined the day.
items.tip: Continuous: One Unbroken Stream.

items.en: Disinterested means fair and unbiased; uninterested means not interested.
items.ex: A disinterested referee is needed, not an uninterested one.
items.tip: A disinterested judge can still be very interested.

items.en: Complacent means overly pleased with oneself, while complaisant means eager to please others.
items.bn: কমপ্লেসেন্ট মানে আত্মতুষ্ট, এবং কমপ্লিজেন্ট মানে অন্যের মন জোগাতে প্রস্তুত।
items.hi: कम्प्लेसेंट का अर्थ है आत्मसंतुष्ट, और कम्प्लिजेंट का अर्थ है दूसरों को प्रसन्न करने के लिए उत्सुक।

tr.mr: स्वयंन्तुष्ट विरुद्ध इतरांना खूश करण्यास उत्सुक
tr.te: అహంభావం గల మరియు ఇతరులను సంతోషపెట్టడానికి ఆసక్తిగా ఉన్న
tr.gu: આત્મસંતુષ્ટ અને બીજાને ખુશ કરવા આતુર
tr.ur: خود مطمئن بمقابلہ دوسروں کو خوش کرنے کا خواہشمند
tr.or: ଆତ୍ମସନ୍ତୁଷ୍ଟ ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଖୁସି କରିବାକୁ ଆଗ୍ରହୀ
tr.pa: ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਤੋਂ ਖੁਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਖੁਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਉਤਸੁਕ
tr.as: আত্মসন্তুষ্ট আৰু আনক সন্তুষ্ট কৰিবলৈ আগ্ৰহী

items.ex: The complacent leader ignored clear signs of trouble, remaining too complaisant toward his careless team.
items.tip: Complacent has 'ant' like an ant sitting lazily on its mound, while complaisant has 'aisle' where you walk down to please guests.

items.en: Flaunt means to show off proudly, whereas flout means to openly break a rule.
items.bn: ফ্লন্ট মানে অহংকার করে দেখানো, আর ফ্লআউট মানে নিয়ম অমান্য করা।
items.hi: फ्लॉन्ट का अर्थ है शान दिखाना, जबकि फ्लाउट का अर्थ है नियम तोड़ना।

tr.as: প্ৰদৰ্শন কৰা আৰু নিয়ম উলংঘা কৰা

items.ex: Do not flaunt your new gadget if you plan to flout the strict classroom no-phone policy.
items.tip: Flaunt has 'aunt' who loves showing off jewels, while flout has 'out' meaning throwing rules out.

items.en: Tortuous refers to a winding, twisting path, while torturous means causing severe pain.
items.bn: টর্টোয়াস মানে বাঁকানো বা প্যাঁচালো, আর টর্টোরাস মানে মারাত্মক যন্ত্রণাদায়ক।
items.hi: टॉर्टुअस का अर्थ है घुमावदार, और टॉर्टुरस का अर्थ है बेहद दर्दनाक।
items.ex: The tortuous mountain drive proved torturous for everyone prone to severe car sickness.
items.tip: Torturous has 'torture' right inside it to remind you of extreme pain.

items.en: A prodigy is an exceptionally gifted child, whereas progeny refers to offspring or descendants.
items.bn: প্রডিজি মানে বিস্ময়কর প্রতিভাবান শিশু, আর প্রোজেনি মানে সন্তানাদি।
items.hi: प्रोडीजी का अर्थ है असाधारण प्रतिभाशाली बच्चा, जबकि प्रोजेनी का अर्थ है संतान।
items.ex: The musical prodigy left proud progeny to carry forward his legendary classical melodies.
items.tip: Prodigy sounds like product of genius, while progeny sounds like generation of family.

items.en: Prescribe means to recommend a remedy or rule, while proscribe means to strictly forbid something.
items.bn: প্রেসক্রাইব মানে কোনো চিকিৎসা বা নিয়ম দেওয়া, আর প্রোসক্রাইব মানে নিষিদ্ধ করা।
items.hi: प्रिस्क्राइब का अर्थ है सलाह देना या नुस्खा लिखना, और प्रोस्क्राइब का अर्थ है पाबंदी लगाना।
items.ex: Doctors prescribe healthy diets while local health laws proscribe harmful chemical additives.
items.tip: Pre means before (writing a prescription), while pro sounds like 'pro-hibit' (banning).

items.en: Appraise means to assess value, whereas apprise means to inform or notify someone.
items.bn: অ্যাপরাইজ মানে মূল্য নির্ধারণ করা, এবং অ্যাপরাইজ মানে কাউকে জানানো।
items.hi: अप्रेज का अर्थ है मूल्यांकन करना, जबकि अप्राइज का अर्थ है सूचित करना।

tr.ur: قدر معلوم کرنا بمقابلہ مطلع کرنا

items.ex: Bank officials will apprise you once they properly appraise your ancestral property.
items.tip: Appraise has 'praise' which bosses do after valuing your work, while apprise has 'rise' like a rising news alert.

items.en: Urban refers to cities, while urbane describes someone smooth and sophisticated.
items.bn: আরবান মানে শহুরে এবং আর্বেন মানে মার্জিত ও ভদ্র।
items.hi: अर्बन का संबंध शहर से है और अर्बेन का अर्थ शिष्ट और सभ्य है।
items.ex: An urban planner wearing a fine suit gave an urbane speech at the seminar.
items.tip: Urban has c for city, urbane ends in e like elegance.

items.en: Deprecate means to express strong disapproval, whereas depreciate means to lose value over time.
items.bn: ডেপ্রেভেট মানে নিন্দা করা এবং ডেপ্রিসিয়েট মানে মূল্য হ্রাস পাওয়া।
items.hi: डेप्रेकेट का अर्थ निंदा करना है और डेप्रिसिएट का अर्थ मूल्य घटना है।

tr.mr: निंदा करणे विरुद्ध मूल्य कमी होणे
tr.or: ନିନ୍ଦା କରିବା ଏବଂ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇବା
tr.as: নিন্দা কৰা আৰু মূল্য হ্ৰাস পোৱা

items.ex: Do not deprecate his idea just because old cars depreciate quickly.
items.tip: Depreciate has price in it, relating to money value.

items.en: Enervate means to drain strength, while energize means to fill with fresh energy.
items.bn: এনার্ভেট মানে শক্তি কমানো এবং এনার্জাইজ মানে শক্তি যোগানো।
items.hi: एनरवे का अर्थ थकाना है और एनर्जाइज का अर्थ ऊर्जावान बनाना है।
items.ex: The summer heat can enervate you, but a cold drink will energize you.
items.tip: Energize sounds active, enervate drains your energy.

items.en: Judicial relates to courts and judges, whereas judicious means showing wise judgment.
items.bn: জুডিশিয়াল মানে আদালত সংক্রান্ত এবং জুডিশিয়াস মানে বিচারবুদ্ধিসম্পন্ন।
items.hi: जुडिशियल का संबंध अदालत से है और जुडिशियस का अर्थ समझदारी भरा है।
items.ex: The judicial committee made a judicious choice to resolve the dispute.
items.tip: Judicious has wise in it, just like a wise choice.

items.en: Mitigate means to make something less severe, while militate means to work against.
items.bn: মিটিগেট মানে কমানো এবং মিলিটেট মানে বিরোধিতা করা।
items.hi: मिटिगेट का अर्थ कम करना है और मिलिटेट का अर्थ विरोध में काम करना है।
items.ex: Trees help to mitigate pollution, which can militate against health issues.
items.tip: Militate sounds like military fighting against something.

items.en: Fulsome means excessive or insincere praise, whereas copious means abundant in quantity.
items.bn: ফুলসাম মানে অতিরিক্ত বা চাটুকারিতাপূর্ণ এবং কোপিয়াস মানে প্রচুর।
items.hi: फुलसम का अर्थ अत्यधिक या चापलूसी भरा है और कोपियस का अर्थ प्रचुर है।
items.ex: She gave him fulsome praise while taking copious notes during the lecture.
items.tip: Copious rhymes with copious copy, meaning lots of notes.
